messages.text:
BL-1424 — A commit that adds a test file under swarmforge/scripts/test/ with no suite-manifest.tsv row is refused by the pre-commit guard chain: BL-1240 fires only at a parcel's git_handoff, so hotfix 27d6ab8630 (a human commit straight onto main) added two unregistered files on 2026-09-02 and the standing suite refused every run for three days before anyone was told; the guard judges only the files the commit itself adds, never pre-existing drift
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-05 by the specifier as the companion to BL-1423, on the
coordinator's note (verbatim in BL-1423's source). The coordinator asked
only for the two rows; the specifier minted this because the trace showed
no existing gate CAN see a hotfix, the hotfix ledger shows the path is
taken seve…
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. The one design decision - the guard runs on EVERY commit in every checkout, not only on main - is record…
BL-1424 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1424" (or "reject BL-1424 <reason>") to act.
